source_document.body:
Amazon’s Fall Prime Day Sale event is over, but that doesn’t mean the savings are slowing down, and we’re keeping all the ongoing deals in our updated Fall Prime Day Green Deals hub here for the rest of the week. Leading today’s edition of Green Deals is the latest and final EcoFlow Prime Day flash sale running for 72 hours , with offers like the 2x 1,024Wh DELTA 3 Classic power station bundle down at $889 , alongside some other notable units from $599. Right behind that we have collected all the ongoing Segway Fall Deals Deals Day Sale savings on e-scooters, with continuing options like the ZT3 Pro Off-Road Electric Scooter down at $800 . We also have Anker’s SOLIX Prime Deals Encore Sale offering the 2,048Wh C2000 Gen 2 Portable Power Station with a 400W solar panel at an exclusive $1,330 , among others, as well as the Segway Navimow i2 Series Robot Mowers at their lowest prices, a continuing low price on EGO’s 56V 12-inch Electric Snow Shovel, and more options hanging onto savings for a while longer.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Get 2x 1,024Wh DELTA 3 Classic power stations at $889 in latest EcoFlow flash sale ($309 off), more from $599
As part of EcoFlow’s ongoing Prime Big Deal Days Sale , the brand has launched a 72-hour flash sale with up to 52% discounts on four units to lead us to the end of the event. One inclusion that we’ve seen in past flash sales that is getting more savings is the option for 2x 1,024Wh DELTA 3 Classic Portable Power Stations down at $889 shipped , beating Amazon by $109 . Down from $1,198 during this sale, we’ve been seeing repeated appearances of this offer in flash sales spaced out over the course of the last few months, with it often cut down between $938 and $979 during those periods, though there were drops as low as $879 in 2026. The deal here provides a 26% markdown for $309 savings off the tag, landing it at the second-lowest price this year, just $10 above the annual low that last appeared in July. Head below to browse the other flash sale offers for 6kWh and 8kWh bundles, or check out the full lineup of deals here before they end this weekend.
EcoFlow’s final Fall Prime Day flash sale:
Smart Dual Fuel Generator 3000: $599 (Reg. $749)
2x DELTA 3 Classic (1,024Wh each) power stations: $889 (Reg. $1,198) | $109 more at Amazon
2x DELTA 3 Ultra (3,072Wh each) power stations: $2,398 (Reg. $4,998) | $340 more at Amazon
DELTA Pro 3 (8,192Wh) with expansion battery: $4,229 (Reg. $5,598) | $230 more at Amazon
Segway’s extended Fall Deals Day Sale offers ZT3 Pro off-road e-scooter at $700 ($300 off), more from $150
Segway has an ongoing Fall Deals Day Sale running with up to 50% off its e-scooter lineup, as well as the discounts on its e-bikes alongside a special Buy 2 get $200 off promotion . While some models have seen slight increases, one option keeping to its price is the ZT3 Pro Off-Road Electric Scooter down at $799.99 shipped , matching over at Amazon . Don’t be fooled by the $1,300 MSRP tag you see, as it usually can be found going as high as $1,000 throughout the year, with most of the discounts we’ve seen in 2026 having kept things at $850 or higher. Prime Day gave us a fall lower to this same rate, which is continuing the $300 markdown ($600 off the MSRP) for the same pricing we saw during June’s Prime Day event, sitting just $27 above the all-time low from January.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
You can browse the full lineup of deals here through October 18, as well as the e-bike deals in our original coverage here .
Anker’s Prime Deals Encore Sale offers 2,048Wh C2000 Gen 2 station + 400W panel at exclusive $1,330, more from $900
Anker currently has a Fall Prime Deals Encore Sale running through to next week , giving you prolonged power station savings at up to 38% off, not to mention our exclusive bonus savings code, and continued FREE gifts. One of my favorite bundles that I’ve been regularly using since last year is the 2,048Wh C2000 Gen 2 Portable Power Station with a 400W solar panel down at $1,330 shipped , after using the code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout, which beats Amazon’s pricing by $170 . You may see a $2,000 MSRP on it, but it can regularly be found starting from $1,899 these days, with the last two days of the sale event having been down at $1,320. While we have seen it go lower in the past before prices began rising back up due to ongoing tariff pressure, this is still a solid $569 in combined savings that gives you a highly reliable power companion, as I described in my hands-on review .
***Note: We have not factored in the bonus 5% off savings into the prices you see below, so be sure to use our exclusive code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout on orders over $1,000, as well as the code USAFF5 on orders under that threshold, though, again, this latter code might not always stack on certain deals.
Top picks from Anker’s SOLIX Fall Prime Deals Encore Sale:
C2000 Gen 2 (2,048Wh) power station: $900 (Reg. $1,500)
2x S2000 (2,010Wh each) power stations: $1,300 (Reg. $2,000)
C2000 Gen 2 (2,048Wh) with 400W solar panel: $1,400 (Reg. $1,899)
F3000 (3,072Wh) power station: $1,400 (Reg. $1,700)
F3000 (3,072Wh) with 400W solar panel: $1,900 (Reg. $2,600)
F3800 (3,840Wh) power station: $1,980 (Reg. $2,200)
F3000 (6,144Wh) with expansion battery: $2,230 (Reg. $3,200)
F3800 Plus (3,840Wh) power station: $2,400 (Reg. $2,700)
F3000 (12,288Wh) with 3x expansion batteries: $3,800 (Reg. $6,299)
F3800 Plus (7,680Wh) with expansion battery: $3,999 (Reg. $4,299)
2x F3800s (3,840Wh each) with Double Power Hub: $4,159 (Reg. $4,890)
2x F3800 Plus (3,840Wh each) with Smart Home Power Kit: $5,440 (Reg. $7,800)
And much more…
Bring home Segway’s i206 AWD and i215 LiDAR robot mowers at best prices to date from $849, more
Running through into next week, Segway Navimow is continuing its Fall Sale that began with Amazon’s Prime Big Deals Day event. Like we saw at Amazon, this gives you a ongoing opportunity to pick up the brand’s 2026 Segway Navimow i206 AWD Robot Lawn Mower down at $849 shipped , which is currently sold out at Amazon , as well as the upgraded Navimow i215 LiDAR Robot Lawn Mower down at $1,329 shipped , which is also now out of stock at Amazon . These two models were seen dropping from their $999 and $1,599 full price tags at the start of the week. The ongoing savings cuts $150 and $270 off the tags for the all-time lowest prices we have tracked. There’s also some bundle options for them, as well as alternate models rounded up for you below.
Segway’s ongoing Fall Sale offers:
i206 AWD Robot Lawn Mower: $849 (Reg. $999)
i215 LiDAR Robot Lawn Mower: $1,329 (Reg. $1,599)
i206 with garage bundle: $949 (Reg. $1,199)
i215 with garage bundle: $1,579 (Reg. $1,849)
And much more…
Score the EGO 56V 12-inch cordless electric snow shovel at its $199 low ahead of winter
While Amazon’s Fall Prime Day event is over, we’re still seeing a lot of deals holding out, like EGO’s 56V 12-inch Cordless Electric Snow Shovel (tool only) down at $199 shipped . Down from $279 for Prime Day, this deal is hanging on for an unknown amount of time longer. You’ll save $80 off the going rate here, giving you a prolonged opportunity to pick it up ahead of winter at the all-time lowest price we have tracked. You’ll also find more hangover deals from the last few days in our updated Fall Prime Day Green Deals hub here .
You can learn about this snow shovel’s features in our original coverage here .
Yozma’s IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike is back at an exclusive $1,699 low ($700 off) + IN 10 model at $999 ($600 off)
Get two of Eve’s HomeKit Aqua smart water controllers with $125 Prime Day savings to a new $175 low
Lectric’s Better-Than-Prime Sale cuts XPeak2 off-road e-bike bundle to new $1,299 low, more from $799
Govee’s permanent outdoor lights up to $160 off from $350, like the new 200-foot 2 Pro model at a new $640 low
Velotric’s Fall Prime Day Sale offers first discount on new Summit 2 mixed-terrain smart e-bike for $1,999, more
Best new Green Deals landing this week
The savings this week are also continuing to a collection of other markdowns. To the same tune as the offers above, these all help you take a more energy-conscious approach to your routine. Winter means you can lock in even better off-season price cuts on electric tools for the lawn while saving on EVs and tons of other gear.
Extended Fall Prime Day 2026 Green Deals: EVs, power stations, electric tools, smart devices, and much more [Updated]
